rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly: ~ subject + condition as the full model with an LRT against ~ subject for the any-condition test, then the three pairwise Wald contrasts with control explicitly releveled as reference, ashr shrinkage (correctly justified over apeglm for the non-reference contrast), and BH at a stated alpha within each contrast with independent filtering on. QC is blind VST PCA and distance heatmap coloured by both subject and condition with a flag-only outlier policy and library-size check; the filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples) is minimal and tied to the smallest group; normalization is median-of-ratios inside DESeq2 with no pre-scaling. Enrichment was not requested but is done properly (fgsea on the Wald stat over the full tested list, named human collections with release, 15-500 window, seed, universe stated). The report specifies method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, overlap between treatment responses, and the n=4 and per-contrast-FDR caveats; the only minor quibbles are the slightly over-elaborate length-offset caveat and that QC outlier handling is descriptive rather than a stated exclusion rule.
